question: Should this hardened installer expose configurable extra apt and npm package installation for provider dependencies such as Gemini CLI, and what execution context and package-source limits are acceptable?
rationale: The code change may be bounded, but executing user-specified OS or npm packages during install changes the installer supply-chain boundary.

options.title: Approve narrow package hooks
options.body: Add documented extra package variables with defaults empty, clear root versus openclaw-user execution context, and syntax/check-mode validation.

options.title: Decline arbitrary package hooks
options.body: Keep provider-specific CLIs as manual post-install steps to avoid expanding installer code-execution scope.

options.title: Document provider-specific setup only
options.body: Document the Gemini CLI workaround without adding generic package-manager execution to the playbook.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow package hooks
recommendation.body: Add documented extra package variables with defaults empty, clear root versus openclaw-user execution context, and syntax/check-mode validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work adjusted pnpm idempotency, install paths, and CI harnesses near the affected package installation surface.
